description: A card's new retail price (median of 3+ sellers) against its live on-demand rental rates: months of rental, at the cheapest rate card and at the median, that equal the purchase price, at 100%, 70%, 50% and 25% of a 730-hour month. Rental fee only - power, hosting, the server around the card and resale are not counted. Without gpu, every card that has a retail median.

gpu.description: GPU id or name, e.g. rtx-4090; omit for every card with a retail median.
